text_block_list.text:
"What sheer humiliation, to lose in a 
place like this!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"How frustrating...! It's infuriating...! 
At this rate, unifying the realm is still 
far out of reach!"
choice_data_list: Let's learn from this mistake next time.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Even the great Tokugawa Ieyasu lost 
battles, after all. He used his defeats as 
a lesson to admonish himself—"
choice_data_list: この失敗は次に活かそう
choice_data_list_en: Let's learn from this mistake for next time.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! When it comes to admonishing 
oneself after a defeat, nothing beats 
Tokugawa Ieyasu's Portrait of the Battle 
of Mikatagahara!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So that I never forget this frustration, 
paint a portrait capturing my remorseful 
face in defeat!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...What's this, a smartphone camera? Very 
well, make sure you capture this face 
properly!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that we've left that 
frustration behind, all that's left is to 
win next time!
